beats.text: In 1900, three lighthouse keepers vanished from a rock off Scotland.
The clock had stopped. Two of their three storm coats were gone.
Then the investigator walked down to the west landing.
A box of ropes, a hundred and ten feet above the sea, had been smashed open.
Iron railings were bent. A boulder weighing over a ton had moved.
Something came up that cliff and took all three men.
The sea never gave them back.
